policies.title: Afghan ordinary passports: Grenada advance visa
policies.summary: Grenada's official schedule assigns Afghanistan to Prior to Arrival, meaning that the visa must be obtained from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Obtain the ordinary short-visitor visa from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside this classification.

policies.title: Afghan ordinary passports: Mongolia advance mission visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's general rule requires a visa application at a diplomatic mission; Afghanistan appears in neither the current closed exemption schedule nor the eVisa eligibility list.
conditions: Apply for the appropriate ordinary short-visitor visa through a Mongolian diplomatic mission before travel.
This classification combines the general visa rule with the current closed exemption and eVisa lists; it does not infer eligibility for special routes.

policies.title: Afghan ordinary passports: Panama authorized visa
policies.summary: Panama's current Embassy guidance names Afghanistan in its authorized-visa list and requires an in-person consular process before the visa is granted.
conditions: Apply in person for the authorized visa and wait for approval before finalizing travel.
The separate waiver based on a qualifying third-country visa or residence permit is excluded from the ordinary-passport baseline.

policies.title: Afghan ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visa baseline
policies.summary: Türkiye's current MFA guidance requires an ordinary Afghan-passport holder to have a visa and limits eVisa access to travellers with specified third-country visas or residence permits.
conditions: This is the unconditional ordinary-passport baseline for a short visit; obtain the appropriate visa before travel.
The eVisa route requiring a qualifying Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland visa or residence permit is excluded.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's MFA makes eVisa access conditional on a qualifying third-country visa or residence permit, which the project excludes from the ordinary-passport baseline.
The current full entry and visa-issuance suspension, valid-visa grandfathering and limited exceptions cannot be faithfully flattened to a normal visitor visa status.
